_comment: METRICS 6.9 and 6.11, checked by spec/tools/perf_score.py and generated from spec/tools/perf_score_cases.py (--write), whose expectations are written by hand. Times are Unix ms; days are UTC dates here (the apps use local dates). `edges`: the integer latency edges E_0 … E_64 = ⌈100 · 2^(j/4)⌉. `latencyBins`: a latency in ms -> its bucket. `agents`: each agent's responses (engine form, 3.3) and stored actions (6.10, file order) -> at `nowMs` the 6.9 evaluation (form, unrounded score, shown, provisional, n, tools = |C|, activeMs, spanStartMs, model of the newest sample response, the seven components with presence, reason, samples, measure, ratio and sub-score; with `history` and `today` also the baseline, vsUsual and vsUsualPercent). `sets`: agents' values -> the value of the whole set and of every board group, with the supplying agent. `days`: each agent's completions in the order they complete -> the history records per (day, source, model). `pooled`: records of one source -> the pooled evaluation. `baseline`: records -> the 14-day baseline of (source, model) before `today`. `range`: records -> the History window's rows over [first, last] (one source when `source` is given) with the daily trend. `thinking`: the live thinking line (6.9 Live thinking). Numbers compare within 1e-9 (relative above 1).

agents.name: every component present: five Claude responses, four tool calls in the span, a 14-day baseline

queries.note: 300 s without a line: idle, the same score rests

agents.name: lower clamps: T at 0.01, U and S at 0.05; L, R and H short of samples; n = 3 is enough

queries.note: the calls end after nowMs: none is in C yet

agents.name: newest 20 with a tie broken by key; the last 64 stored actions; the 15-minute limit; T above 20 is not clamped; L below 250 ms counts as 250
upper clamps: N at 20; a 10 ms call counts as 50 ms; a cache hit of 0 at the 0.05 floor
an even count takes the mean of the two middle latencies; a slow first content clamps at 0.05
components a source does not record are left out, marked notRecorded
provisional below 10 responses; the window keeps a response whose end is exactly 30 minutes old

queries.note: endMs above nowMs is not read yet: one response

sets.name: the highest live value wins over a higher resting one; a group takes its members' highest
ties: the latest lastLineMs supplies the value, then the smallest id (ordinal)
no live value: the highest resting one; nothing at all: none

days.name: records per day, source and model: measured responses only, calls within 15 minutes, the online union rule for activeMs, a response ending after midnight, a model-less call

pooled.name: pooled sums over days: the median latency bin, components with enough samples, Σ n = 20
an even count takes the ⌈count/2⌉-th value
Σ n = 19: the components are shown, there is no score
a source without latency or actions: notRecorded, as in the live score

baseline.name: the 14 days before today, this source and model only: Σ n = 19, no baseline
one more record inside the 14 days: Σ n = 20, T = 20 000 / 400 s = 50
another model of the same source has its own baseline (T = 60 000 / 300 s = 200 -> 4)

range.name: per source and model over the range; a day below 20 responses is a gap in the trend
one source chosen in the window's source picker

windows.name: a measured response: grade plus 20 × its thinking share
models weigh by their output in the window; an orb counts its own sources
an in-flight agent is estimated with its reference set's speed and thinking share
DeepSeek Harness adds its grade but not to the thinking share
an unmeasured response is estimated like an in-flight agent
unknown model and effort count as standard and medium; reasoning is capped at output

agentWindows.name: a generating agent counts its measured response and its in-flight estimate; an idle agent rests on its grade; a generating agent without a model or an estimate has none
two agents of one source: each shows its own value and the source blends them; at rest an agent shows the grade of its current effort
a sub-agent is an agent of its own: its parent's value never includes it; an unmeasured response counts for its own agent
an agent without a model is live while its estimate exists, from another agent's responses; it has no grade of its own and weighs as an unknown model
an agent's grade takes the provider of its latest response that names one

groupWindows.name: a group row weighs its root and every sub-agent by the tokens they write, never an average of their values; at rest it shows the root's grade, not that of the sub-agent active last
a group whose root has no model is live from its sub-agents' estimate and has no value at rest, even when a sub-agent has a grade; a sub-agent whose parent is not listed heads its own group

modelWindows.name: every model weighs by its own responses' output in the window, never by the agent that wrote them

an in-flight estimate goes to the agent's current model, its finished response to the response's own; a source without separate reasoning adds weight and no share; an agent without an estimate adds nothing
